name: Wren
source: Robin's childhood friend, whom she hasn't seen for over ten years. With a keen eye for details and a love of games, it's no wonder he became a detective. He says he's on the train to investigate the murder of a famous jeweler and, whether he recognizes her or not, he seems to have a special interest in Robin.
